title: SREV-178 MountManager wire string shape
contracts: MountManager owns the ImBox broker request string-shape gate before mount unmount enum query or create logic consumes request fields
Fixed password[129] fields must contain L'\0' inside the declared array before C-string or password-handoff logic
Fixed reg_root[MAX_REG_ROOT_LEN] fields must contain L'\0' inside the declared array before map lookup lock release protect or unprotect logic
Flexible file_root[1] tails must contain L'\0' inside MSG_HEADER.length before GetImageFileName wcsrchr OpenOrCreateNtFolder or CreateJunction
CreateHandler rejects a terminated create file_root with no backslash before using the wcsrchr result as a range boundary
SbieDll_Mount initializes the full outbound IMBOX_MOUNT_REQ including admin_only before setting fields
SbieDll_Mount rejects BoxKey values that do not fit password[129] before wcscpy
This SREV does not change ImDisk discovery encryption policy reparse point creation removal box-root ownership UseFileImage UseRamDisk or API_PROTECT_ROOT semantics
runtime_gate: Windows service and DLL build plus malformed IMBOX broker-message runtime proof and normal mount unmount query protected-root smoke
